basics.name: Pavel Slajnev
basics.label: System Administrator · DevOps & Automation
basics.summary: IT and automation specialist with 12+ years of experience across DevOps, network infrastructure, and industrial automation, including 9 years leading automation, IT, and electrical systems at Moldova's largest hospital (IMSP SCR Timofei Moșneaga). Delivered 20+ CCTV and network infrastructure projects end-to-end, from design and procurement to commissioning, and built internal automation tools in Python. Currently expanding into backend/API development and AI-agent tooling (FastAPI, MCP) as a System Administrator at Strategic Software.

Python programming: development and maintenance of internal tools, automation scripts, and backend services.
Development and integration of REST APIs (FastAPI, JSON) for internal and client-facing systems.

Delivered a large-scale international VoIP project (3CX) for a major company in Romania, under NDA — full lifecycle from server deployment to end-user configuration (SIP phones) and SIP trunks.

projects.name: scada-shop.ro – E-commerce Website Implementation
projects.description: End-to-end implementation of the new online shop, built on the MerchantPro e-commerce platform, as the single programmer, using AI-assisted development tools (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot).
highlights: Analysis & preparation: Audit of the existing site, full backups, reverse-engineering of the current code and data before any change.
New design: New modern, responsive UI/UX design for desktop and mobile.
Development: Implementation and refactoring of working, maintainable code for the shop features (MerchantPro theme: Twig templates, SCSS, JavaScript).
Full optimization: Performance, page speed, SEO, security and accessibility optimization of the whole site.
Pipeline: Git-based development pipeline: version control, testing and automated deployment to production.
Production launch: Built and tested on the staging site new.scada-shop.ro, then launched to production at scada-shop.ro.
Ongoing: Continuous improvements, monitoring and maintenance.

projects.name: Kanban Team – multi-user task board (pet project)
projects.description: A self-hosted Kanban board for teams, grown from my personal to-do app. One code base runs both the single-user and the team version.
roles: Solo developer (idea, architecture, code, tests, deployment)
highlights: Capabilities: Teams with own columns, task transfer and delegation, notifications, history and audit log, attachments, checklists, labels, timer and statistics; sign-in with passwords and passkeys; live sync between all interfaces (web app, AI assistants via MCP, Telegram bots, Super Productivity plugin); installable app with offline mode; EN/RO/RU interface, light/dark theme.

Pdf endpoint: PDF attachments with in-app preview (pdf.js) and electronic signing: through MSign (Moldova's government e-signature service, SOAP 1.1 API with the return callback), the MSign portal, or the user's own .p12/.pfx certificate in the browser; every signed copy is checked for a valid signature and saved as a new attachment next to the original.
Quality: Automated tests (unit, API permission matrix, GUI, browser, reverse proxy, production smoke test) on every push, daily backups, user/admin/API guides with screenshots in three languages.

Opportunities: Ready to deploy on a client server, behind any reverse proxy or as a Windows portable app; planned storage in Git / S3 with encryption at rest; can be offered as a self-hosted task manager for small companies.
